parole.testo: Borrowed from Middle High German klōster, cf. German Kloster, from Vulgar Latin *clōstrum (“enclosed (area)”).

Derived from Middle High German lanne (“chain”), from Old High German lanna (“metal sheet, platelet; chain”), from Vulgar Latin lanna from Latin lāmina (“sheet especially of metal”).
